segments.sensitive: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin and eczema reports no irritation and improved tone and texture; another, whose skin turned sensitive with menopause, reports no breakouts and hydration.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry, sensitive skin and eczema reports improved skin tone and texture without irritation.
segments.mature: A 50-year-old reviewer describes her skin as more breakout-prone, dull, and sensitive due to menopause, and reports better hydration and no breakouts after about three weeks.

concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: one reviewer not usually acne-prone says the toner broke her out badly after a single use, while two others (one menopausal and breakout-prone, one with eczema) report zero acne issues or breakouts.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer with dry, sensitive skin and eczema reports no irritation, and a menopausal reviewer with dermatitis says the condition is improving.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the toner as hydrating, including one who uses it as the first step in a 'skin flooding' routine.
concerns.aging: One 50-year-old reviewer reports her dull, breakout-prone skin improved with better hydration and no new issues, though she does not describe fine lines or wrinkles specifically.

extraits.texte: I am NOT acne prone by any means but THIS broke me out so bad after 1 use!

I just started using Medicube about 3 weeks ago! I'm 50 yrs old and my skin has become more breakout-prone, dull, and thanks to menopause, it has become sensitive to everything. I haven't had any issues with breaking out at all. It has really hydrated my skin and complemented the other Medicube products that I have. I use the hypochlorous acid spray first. Which is AMAZING! I also use the Cica pads, Pore Zero, collagen masks, and Vitamin C cream. My skin has never looked better and I have had zero acne issues, and my dermatitis is going away!! Definitely will be repurchasing!!

I feel like I rarely see a chance but I notice my skin tone and texture becoming better after just a few uses and now that I'm through my first bottle and about to buy another I 10/10 recommend. I have dry sensitive skin & eczema and had no problems with irritation

extraits.titre: I would definitely buy this again!
extraits.texte: Medicube is one of my favorite skincare products! This toner makes my face feel so soft and hydrated.
Amazing product! Non-comedogenic! Not heavy! Much better than all american brands in the same and even higher price range

reserve: Only nine reviews are available and most give little detail on skin type or concern, so conclusions for underrepresented segments like oily, combination, or normal skin cannot be drawn.
